AD_Window.DESCRIPTION: Enter and track work order transactions
AD_Window.HELP: Enter work order transactions manually or create them in bulk using the Generate Work Operation Requirements or Generate Resource Charges windows. Use transactions to: - Issue material out of inventory to the work order shop floor, - Return un-consumed material back to inventory, - Charge resource usage, - Execute manufacturing operations that consume material and create sub-assemblies and the final product assembly, - Complete a manufactured product assembly into inventory and, - Return a manufactured product assembly from inventory back to the shop floor for rework.
AD_Window.NAME: VAMFG_WorkOrderTransaction
